mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate, as measured by the 3-month moving average, compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate compresses liquidity and raises discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1 and the regime is monetary tightening, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of positive GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.1
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 0.5% and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
